name: FourKites
tagline: FourKites tracks shipments across truck, rail, ocean, and air in real time and uses machine learning to predict arrival times and flag disruptions before they hit a schedule. Logistics teams use it to cut down on manual check-calls and respond to delays while there is still time to act.
